about_the_game:
You wake up in the hospital with no memories. They tell you that you were found among the survivors of a landslide that buried a small village called Inusai, with only some spare change in your pocket. Nobody knows who you are or where you came from, but you are undoubtedly connected to the village in some way. Determined to uncover what happened to you, you set off to investigate the site, hoping that something will trigger at least some fleeting memory. Everything becomes even more complicated when you discover the village is still completely intact and its residents are behaving as if nothing happened. Very soon, however, you realize you can no longer leave, and that nothing is as it seems.

In this visual novel, take on the role of Yuuki and work alongside Ihayase Araka, sent by The Exorcist Association to investigate the eerie village that should have been buried beneath the landslide. Disguised as a detective, interrogate villagers and assist other survivors who are stuck in the village just like you. Make choices along the way that will shape your path and determine your success—or your demise.

Choices Matter

You will face decisions along the way that will shape your journey. Some choices might save a life, or might even lead to your early demise, so tread carefully!

Multiple Endings

There is more than one ending, and not all of them end in a happily ever after. Can you uncover them all?

A World to Get Drawn Into

The game boasts a winding story story filled with rich lore, engaging dialogue, and mysteries to uncover.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7/8/8.1/10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In this gripping visual novel, step into the shoes of Yuuki, a boy with amnesia, and team up with top-tier exorcist Ihayase Araka. Together, you must uncover the dark secrets of Inusai Village and piece together your forgotten past.
supported_languages:
English, Japanese*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
